name: Ma Pi Leng Pass
kicker: The high road above the Nho Quế
summary: High road from Đồng Văn to Mèo Vạc: ride the rim above the Nho Quế for most of a morning. The pass rises to 1,200 metres. Mèo Vạc is 24 km on, and the stops fill the time. This road is also called Happiness Road. Stop where the shoulder allows, and finish in daylight.
timeNeeded: Most of a morning with the stops
getThere: The road from Đồng Văn toward Mèo Vạc
heroCaption: Tu Sản canyon and the Nho Quế from Mã Pì Lèng, the road on the rim

notice.title: Stop only where the shoulder allows
notice.body: The rim has little room beside the lane. Make the stops in daylight and leave the curves clear.

body: Ride the rim between Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc. The pass rises to 1,200 metres. The road is the sight: karst on one side, the canyon on the other. Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn and takes most of a morning if you stop.

The same pass is called Happiness Road. Work on it started in the late 1950s and took more than seven years. Above the river, the sky path is a separate walk of 500 metres, about two hours, through Flower Hmong villages. At the bottom of the pass, side road 193A turns toward the Nho Quế. A boat or a kayak is a June outing, when the river is full.

figures.caption: The road through the karst between Đồng Văn and Mèo Vạc
figures.alt: A curving road through limestone peaks on Ma Pi Leng Pass

gettingThere: The pass is in Mèo Vạc, on the road out of Đồng Văn. It rises to 1,200 metres. That figure is the pass. Hà Giang town sits far lower, and the pass is a different place from the town.

Mèo Vạc is 24 km from Đồng Văn. With stops, the ride takes most of a morning. Daylight only. Happiness Road is another name for this pass. The build started in the late 1950s and took more than seven years.
